wind_step.name: Wind Step
wind_step.lore: A fluid Lumorian discipline that bends momentum and air. Practitioners strike from impossible angles.

moves.name: Gale Kick
moves.desc: A whipping kick carried on a gust of wind.

moves.name: Sky Step
moves.desc: Leap upward — your next move comes from above. Cannot miss.

moves.name: Cyclone Cut
moves.desc: A spinning blade of compressed air.

sun_walk.name: Sun Walk
sun_walk.lore: A radiant style taught only in the Sanctuary's inner courtyard. Each step burns its impression into the air.

moves.name: Solar Step
moves.desc: A scorching forward stride.

moves.name: Flare Palm
moves.desc: A bright palm-strike that dazzles.

moves.name: Dawn Pillar
moves.desc: Call down a column of solar fire.

tide_veil.name: Tide Veil
tide_veil.lore: Harmony's defensive water form, taught by the Sanctuary's tide-keepers. Strikes ride the rhythm of breath and current.

moves.name: Mending Wave
moves.desc: A soft wave — restores 18 HP to yourself instead of dealing damage.

moves.name: Ripple Strike
moves.desc: A flowing palm-strike that washes back.

moves.name: Drown Press
moves.desc: A heavy press of compressed water; slows the target.

bone_crush.name: Bone Crush
bone_crush.lore: The Purity Order's strike-discipline: no flourish, no waste. Every motion ends in a fracture.

moves.name: Bone Hammer
moves.desc: A heavy overhead strike.

moves.name: Iron Stance
moves.desc: Brace — next incoming hit halved AND counter-strikes for 20 damage.

moves.name: Pillar Drop
moves.desc: A devastating overhead — slow but crushing.

void_sever.name: Void Sever
void_sever.lore: Rift-tongue carving. Each strike pulls a thread of substance out of the world and consumes it.

moves.name: Sever Line
moves.desc: A clean cut across nothing — that takes something with it.

moves.name: Void Drain
moves.desc: Drain energy — deal 30 damage AND restore 6 of your own combat energy.

moves.name: Null Eclipse
moves.desc: Collapse a sliver of the void onto your target.

pyrolexis.name: Pyrolexis
pyrolexis.lore: From the Greek pyr (fire) and lexis (speech). A spoken-art discipline — every move is a syllable the world cannot ignore.

moves.name: Logos Ardens
moves.desc: Latin: 'burning word'. A short utterance that ignites the air around the target.

moves.name: Crepitus
moves.desc: Latin: 'crackling'. Hisses across the gap and lands without fail.

moves.name: Hekatombe
moves.desc: Greek: 'great fire-offering'. A roaring finisher — slow to speak, devastating to hear.

kataphraxis.name: Kataphraxis
kataphraxis.lore: From the Greek kataphraktos (fully armored). Harmony's heavy-plate counter-form, taught to those who would shield others before themselves.

moves.name: Phalanx Step
moves.desc: A measured advance behind raised guard.

moves.name: Aegis Stance
moves.desc: Greek: 'shield-stance'. Brace — next incoming hit halved AND counter-strikes for 25 damage.

moves.name: Citadel
moves.desc: Latin: 'small city, fortress'. Withdraw, brace, and restore 22 HP.

tenebris.name: Tenebris
tenebris.lore: Latin: tenebrae (darkness, gloom). A Rift-borne shadow art — quieter than Void Sever, hungrier.

moves.name: Umbra Caedere
moves.desc: Latin: 'to slay in shadow'. The strike arrives before the sound.

moves.name: Noctis Vorax
moves.desc: Latin: 'night-devourer'. Bite that returns 12 HP to the caster.

moves.name: Eclipsis
moves.desc: Latin: 'eclipse'. A finisher that briefly removes the target from the world.

astrobolos.name: Astrobolos
astrobolos.lore: Greek: astrobolos (star-thrown, struck by stars). A celestial striking art — said to be taught beyond the rim of any temple.

moves.name: Stella Cadens
moves.desc: Latin: 'falling star'. A ranged punch of compressed light.

moves.name: Sidereum Ictus
moves.desc: Latin: 'starry blow'. Cannot miss.

moves.name: Nova Igne
moves.desc: Latin: 'with new fire'. The horizon briefly turns white.

anastasis.name: Anastasis
anastasis.lore: Greek: anastasis (rising, resurrection). The Sanctuary's most sacred discipline — taught to almost no one, and only after great loss.

moves.name: Lux Lenis
moves.desc: Latin: 'gentle light'. Deals quiet damage and returns 10 HP.

moves.name: Velamen Sanans
moves.desc: Latin: 'healing veil'. Restore 35 HP.

moves.name: Resurgentia
moves.desc: Latin: 'rising again'. A final, blinding strike — only spoken when the bearer is ready to spend all of themselves.
